description:
List all Bitcoin Rune etchings (token deployments) with pagination.

Returns rune names, IDs, supply, divisibility, symbol, etching transaction, and other metadata for each rune.

Use runes_get_etching to get full details on a specific rune.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

limit.description: Number of results to return (1-60, default: 20)

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination (default: 0)

name: runes_list_etchings
